title: Grape Pilaf Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry made with grape pilaf as the base, featuring comfort russian and quenched ingredients. Quick and easy to prepare.

ingredients.name: Quenched Green Beans
ingredients.notes: Trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the trimmed and cut green beans, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet.
Stir-fry the mixture for about 4-5 minutes, or until the green beans are tender.
Add the pre-cooked grape pilaf to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, if desired.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving dish and serve immediately.
